# APO Soundboard Scratch Edition v0.9.2

Historical source snapshot matching the **v0.9.2** experimental Windows x64 release package.

**Download the original complete package:** [scratch-v0.9.2](https://github.com/Syed1611/EqualizerAPO-Soundboard/releases/tag/scratch-v0.9.2). Use its attached ZIP (not the autogenerated source archive) for the matched DLL, controller, complete source and any bundled tests.

**Main change:** Pitch-preserving granular scrubbing.

This snapshot preserves the release's source and build notes. It is superseded by [Scratch Edition v0.9.8](https://github.com/Syed1611/EqualizerAPO-Soundboard/releases/tag/scratch-v0.9.8).

The lightweight [v0.9.0](https://github.com/Syed1611/EqualizerAPO-Soundboard/releases/tag/v0.9) edition remains independent.

Read [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) and [BUILDING.txt](BUILDING.txt) for this historical build.
